name: ai-trend-research
description: AI Trend Research Engine - Real-time Google Trends analysis, content generation, and monetization intelligence powered by Google Gemini AI.

scripts.build:api: esbuild api-src/trending.ts api-src/analyze.ts api-src/ai-usage.ts api-src/expand-keywords.ts api-src/generate-content.ts api-src/generate-kdp.ts api-src/monetization.ts api-src/alerts.ts api-src/history.ts api-src/saved-trends.ts api-src/health.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outdir=api
scripts.build: npm run build:api && vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs
